English: Sacred Tree
A revered tree, watched over by the clan, marking the spiritual center of the camp and blessing the people with unity and growth.
Stone Circle
A gathering of ancient stones, arranged by the elders for ritual observances, reinforcing clan bonds and attracting new followers.
Ancestor Shrine
Small wooden altars and offerings to the honored dead, providing guidance, spiritual unity, and a sense of belonging.
Spirit Hut
A simple hut for the tribes shaman, where rituals of protection and guidance are held, strengthening unity and devotion.
Ritual Pavilion
A large, ornate tent of woven cloth where major clan ceremonies and initiations take place, drawing the people together in faith and tradition.
Priests Room
A permanent wooden chamber for the high priest, serving as a seat of spiritual authority, fostering religious harmony and unity.
Sanctified Grove
A fenced forest clearing, watched by chosen guardians, where sacred rites are held and the spirits of the land are honored in great gatherings.
Diviners Chamber
A private, fortified enclosure for the most trusted diviners, who interpret omens and guide the clans destiny, binding all to the old ways.
Blessed Sanctuary
A grand, permanent structure of carved stone and sacred wood, the heart of the clans spiritual life, where unity, growth, and piety flourish.
West African Ritual Grove
The legendary, sacred grove at the heart of the clans land, the holiest of places where all rituals converge, uniting the people and granting unmatched spiritual authority.
